description: Control and monitor the locally installed Genra video editor through its loopback API and ChatGPT's built-in Browser.

defaultPrompt: Turn this idea into a polished video: [describe your idea].
Improve my current video's pacing, structure, and visual flow.
Review my video and make the final edits needed for publishing.
interface.longDescription: Turn ideas into finished videos through conversation. Start with a simple brief, create a complete first draft, refine scenes and pacing, make precise edits, and review every change in a live visual workspace—without navigating a complex editing timeline.

name: genra-video-editor
